overview: A client-side medical education companion that connects to Bluetooth vitals devices, analyses vitals and blood markers against cited clinical ranges, ranks possible conditions, and keeps a local FHIR-inspired health record.
features: Connect a Bluetooth vitals device and see a live chart
Enter blood markers with unit toggles and green/amber/red range indicators
Get ranked possible conditions with plain-language explanations and cited sources
Emergency stop banner for critical readings
Trend sparklines and direction arrows for repeated readings
Local FHIR-inspired health record with tabs, timeline and trend charts
Export the record as JSON or PDF and delete all data
Educational symptom checker with red-flag emergency stop
